testcase_name: Test environment setup (start container, sync tests via run_unit_tests.sh)
description: Prerequisite for every other row below: the tests/ directory lives on the host, not inside the vllm-kvweave container (only /kvweave_quant_src, the read-only source mount, is available there). tests/run_unit_tests.sh copies tests/ and pyproject.toml into a running container and executes pytest there via `docker exec`, so no interactive shell is needed. Add --perf to include the perf-marked benchmarks.
steps: 1. From the repo root on the host, start the container: `integration/vllm/vllm-start.sh` (normal serving) or `DEBUG=1 integration/vllm/vllm-start.sh` (interactive debug shell) — either works, both build kvweave_quant/kvweave_serde and leave a container named `vllm-kvweave` running. 2. From a second host shell (same repo root), run `bash tests/run_unit_tests.sh` to run the full non-perf suite, `bash tests/run_unit_tests.sh --perf` for the benchmarks, or use the per-row invocation below to run a single test.

description: Quantize->dequantize roundtrip accuracy for fp16 input across all qbit (4/8) x scaling_method (per_tensor/per_token/per_channel) x rh/precond x asym combinations, using the Qwen3.5-9B default head geometry (4 KV heads x 256 head_dim) from conftest.py.
Same matrix as UT-001 for bf16 input.
All-zero input dequantizes back to all-zero (max_err < 1e-6) at qbit=8/per_token.
Verifies roundtrip accuracy holds as blocks_num scales (1/4/8 blocks) at qbit=4/per_channel/rh+precond+asym.
get_scales_for_id returns non-empty bytes immediately after quantize_kvcache.
After clear_scales_for_id the scale blob is empty or carries a count=0 header.
set_scales_for_id correctly restores previously-cleared scales so a separate dequantize call reproduces the source within threshold.
Two different scale_ids quantized from different inputs produce distinct scale byte blobs (no cross-talk).
kvweave_serialize_chunk -> kvweave_dequantize_chunk roundtrip accuracy across the full qbit x scaling_method x rh/precond x asym matrix, on synthetic KV chunks with 1% outliers.

testcase_name: Fused path matches manual sequential path
description: Fused kvweave_serialize_chunk output is byte-for-byte identical to the manual quantize+get_scales+pack sequence for the same input (determinism check).
kvweave_dequantize_chunk returns the expected [2, num_layers, T, H*D] shape.
kvweave_dequantize_chunk honors the requested output_dtype (fp16/bf16).

testcase_name: Serde: 4D attention chunk roundtrip keeps 4D layout
description: A [2,1,T,H] 4D tensor serializes to KVW3 and roundtrips while preserving the 4D layout end-to-end.

testcase_name: Serde: 4D multilayer dequantize uses direct path into destination
description: A 3-layer 4D payload's direct dequant call (_cpu_dequantize_into_4d) writes the restored tensor directly into the destination buffer with correct values, and the public deserialize_tensor entry point routes through that same direct 4D dequant path exactly once (no per-layer fallback).

testcase_name: Serde: layer-parallel thread strategy matches direct path across scaling scenarios
description: For a 6-layer 4D chunk, dequantizing with layer_num_threads>1 produces bit-identical output to the single-call direct path, parametrized over per_channel/per_token/per_tensor x rh on/off.

testcase_name: Build and start vLLM + LMCache + KV Quant Offload (default Qwen3.5-9B)
description: Launches the full stack with KV quant offload L1 quant enabled by default (MODEL=Qwen3.5-9B, ENABLE_LMCACHE=1, LMCACHE_MP_L1_KVWEAVE_QUANT=1) and confirms the container builds cleanly and both the LMCache MP server and the vLLM API server come up healthy.
steps: 1. From integration/vllm/, run `./vllm-start.sh` (non-debug; defaults to MODEL=Qwen3.5-9B). 2. Watch container logs for `LMCache /metrics ready: http://localhost:8090/metrics` followed by vLLM's `Uvicorn running on http://0.0.0.0:8000`. 3. Confirm no errors during the kvweave_quant/kvweave_serde build or the lmcache-mp-hybrid.patch apply.

description: Sends a real completion request through the running server to confirm Qwen3.5-9B responds correctly end-to-end through the LMCache MP + KV quant offload path.
steps: 1. With the server from E2E-001 still running, run `./vllm-curl.sh` (defaults to the same MODEL=Qwen3.5-9B). 2. Confirm the response is HTTP 200 with a non-empty completion.
